newsitem.title: SYRIA: Syria offers 50,000 tonnes of wheat for sale.
newsitem.headline: Syria offers 50,000 tonnes of wheat for sale.

text.p: Syria's general establishment for cereal processing and trade (GECPT) has offered 50,000 tonnes of hard durum amber wheat for sale, a company spokesman said on Friday.
He said an international call for prices, setting January 21 as final date to receive bids, had already been issued. Confirmation would be made on January 22.
The amount would be ready for shipment between February 15 and 28. Partial offers would be accepted.
